data.gender_notes: Rasheeq is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rasheeq is an Arabic name derived from the word 'rashiqah' which refers to the head of the family or tribe. The name Rasheeq carries the meaning “Head of the family” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rasheeq usually hope their child will grow to embody head of the family and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Rasheeq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Head of the family.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rasheeq total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The name Rasheeq signifies the importance of strong family leadership and the responsibility that comes with this role. The name also carries respect and authority, implying a sense of pride and dignity associated with the role of a family leader.
